description: FREE (key) — Use to copy or move records between two ListPlus lists. copy records from one list shared with you into another (same kind: contacts or companies) — with `move: true` they are then hidden in the source (restorable, never deleted). A record the target already has is filled in, not doubled; a copy never goes back into a list it came through. Up to 1,000 per call.

filter.description: Column → value: exact, { "contains": "…" }, { "not": "…" }, { "is_empty": true } or { "condition": "<one of filter_conditions>" }; ar_status by status name

move.description: true = hide the records in the source after the copy
